answer.justification: Chronic high-dose analgesic use, especially aspirin plus acetaminophen, is a classic cause of renal papillary necrosis. Sloughed necrotic papillae can obstruct ureters, producing acute colicky flank pain and gross hematuria. Proteinuria supports tubular/interstitial renal involvement, making papillary necrosis more likely than simple nephrolithiasis.
